name: Yellow River
blurb: Yellow River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.putIn: Yellow River Access — Town of Bashaw
sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. This is a long section and may require more than one day; plan daylight, supplies and legal overnight stops. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
